text: Renata and Identity & Access Engineer Grace Liu roll out CA-RequireMFA-AllUsers, requiring MFA for every sign-in across the oakmere-cu tenant.
Three legacy service accounts fail immediately -- no interactive session exists to approve an MFA challenge.
They build one named exclusion group, CA-Legacy-ServiceAccounts-Exempt, with exactly those three accounts, including svc-core-banking-sync.
It's a standard, temporary migration pattern -- with a tracked plan to move all three to certificate-based auth and retire the exemption.
Next: hardening least-privilege identity across Azure AD and AWS IAM side by side.
